_about: Public-domain Henry Ward Beecher (1813-1887), Congregational pastor of Plymouth Church, Brooklyn, for the Word Hoard: Seven Lectures to Young Men (1844), Star Papers (1855), New Star Papers (1859), Eyes and Ears (1862), Freedom and War (1863), the American Rebellion speeches (1864), Prayers in the Congregation (1868), Norwood (1868), Lecture-Room Talks (1870), The Life of Jesus the Christ, vol. 1 (1871), Yale Lectures on Preaching (1872-1874), Evolution and Religion (1885) and Patriotic Addresses (1887), from Internet Archive scans. The many volumes of Plymouth Pulpit sermons are left for a later round. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 57 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hwbeecher-lectures-young-men: Seven lectures to young men on various important subjects : delivered before the young men of Indianapolis, Indiana, during the winter of 1843-4 (Indianapolis : Thomas B. Culter ; Cincinnati : Wm. H. Moore & Co., 1844)
